verdict.rationale: SolidJS components are written with JSX (HTML-like syntax) and plain JavaScript, and render real DOM elements, matching the story of blending markup and logic in one file using familiar web tech; community reports confirm an approachable, React-like developer experience with quick porting of existing HTML/CSS-based components (react-bootstrap port). Some community feedback notes non-intuitive reactivity quirks (destructuring, function-wrapped props) that add friction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CSS integration within components (e.g., CSS Modules/scoped styles) and a first-party single-file component example.
